name: WhatSThis_7
short_caption: The robot lifts its left arm slightly and rotates its open palm upward as if presenting or questioning something.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises its left arm, bending the elbow and rotating the wrist so that the hand opens palm-upward toward the side. Its head tilts slightly toward the raised hand while the right arm remains stationary at its side. After a brief pause in this open position, the robot smoothly lowers the left arm and returns its head to the center, ending in the initial neutral posture.
